title: calonemorchis huegelii
intro: Calonemorchis huegelii, commonly known as the Greenhood orchid, is a species of orchid found in Australia. This plant is known for its unique green-colored labellum (lip), which is responsible for its name. The health benefits of Calonemorchis huegelii include its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
